A space with a point of view

Work feels better
when it fits you.

10Bench is a coworking space for people who want their workday to feel considered, connected, and entirely their own.

Why 10Bench

A little more human. A lot more room.

Not everyone works the same way. Some need the calm of their own focus; others think best in company. Most need a bit of both, depending on the day.

We built 10Bench around that everyday truth. A warm welcome, thoughtfully made places to work, and distinct spaces for the ways a workday can move.

What matters here

Thoughtful by design. Welcoming by nature.

We believe the atmosphere around the work matters. It can invite concentration, make a meeting easier, or simply make the day feel lighter.
